The playing constitutes the performance without a performance already actual to receive it, while its players supply actuality. This gives content to the subsistent-act proposal without furnishing an instance of underived esse. A differentiated primary whole meets the same recipient test. Reaching either existence target still requires existentially adequate content for this very individual. The existing reviewed warrant assessments stand.
